evaluation-system.goal: Independently audit May-agent sessions and project apps, identify evidence-backed risks and improvement opportunities, and report actionable findings to humans and responsible project owners.

session-audit.goal: Independently evaluate completed May-agent sessions and maintain trustworthy scoring evidence.

project-app-audit.goal: Independently inspect project-app progress, risk, waits, and process evidence, then produce owner-facing findings.

finding-delivery.goal: Deliver deduplicated audit findings to responsible project owners and notify humans only when useful.

evaluator-reliability.goal: Keep evaluation.app's own audit pipeline reliable and efficient as ordinary project self-maintenance.

pipeline-health.goal: Monitor evaluation pipeline: is aftermath keeping up? Are there gaps? Is LLM lane useful?

criteria-and-calibration.goal: Maintain trustworthy session-audit criteria, calibrate against human reviews, and version criteria changes.
